theorems.statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (Ω s : Set (Eucl n)) (J : Eucl n → ℝ) (h : Eucl Q → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → IsOpen s → s ⊆ Ω → Bornology.IsBounded s → Continuous Φ → InjOn Φ Ω → Continuous J → (∀ v, 0 ≤ J v) → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' tsupport h ⊆ s → (∀ g : Eucl Q → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → ∫⁻ y in Φ '' s, g y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) = ∫⁻ v in s, ENNReal.ofReal (J v) * g (Φ v) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl n))) → ∫ x in Φ '' Ω, h x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) = ∫ v in Ω, J v * h (Φ v) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl n))
